map.name: Vesk
map.trouble: The Necromancer Vezzek has taken the Weeping Isle and sends the drowned dead up out of Lake Mirrow against the villages on its shore.

guard_bark.specifics: Dolf, the guard at the landward gate of Vesk.

first.speaker: Dolf
first.text: Welcome to the Village of Vesk! The Leaky Bucket is just up the dock road. A warm bed for the weary!

again.speaker: Dolf
again.text: Hmm. You'll want better boots than those around here. It's all mud and fish guts.

later.speaker: Dolf
later.text: Take care out on the Weeping Isle, stranger. Nobody who goes out there comes back the same!

bounty_offer.specifics: Haskin, a fisherman bitten in the reed beds, wants the Giant Leeches there killed.

offer.speaker: Haskin
offer.text:
Kind sir! Help me, please! Look at my legs! I'm bitten all over!

Giant Leeches have come up out of the lake and into the reed beds, west of the village past the drying racks. Nobody can set a net out there now. They nearly had me for breakfast!

If you could clear them out, my boys and me could fish again. Do it and the spell book on my shelf is yours. I never could make heads or tails of it anyhow.

reminder.speaker: Haskin
reminder.text: Oh, my poor legs... Are those Leeches dead yet?

completion.speaker: Haskin
completion.text: The reeds are clear?! We can fish again! Bless you, kind sir! Here's the spell book, as I promised.

journal.text: Kill the Giant Leeches in the reed beds west of Vesk.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Ambrus the Ferryman; the Urchins of the east shore caves stole his spyglass, which he keeps watch on the Weeping Isle with.

offer.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
offer.text: Hail, Wanderer! Want to learn a spell? Then do me a favor. The Urchins in the caves on the east shore stole my spyglass right off my ferry! I can't keep watch on the Weeping Isle without it. Bring it back and I'll teach you a fine spell. Is it a bargain?

refusal.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
refusal.text: No? Then don't come asking me for a ride to the Isle.

reminder.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
reminder.text: Got my spyglass? No? Then what are you standing around for?

completion.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
completion.text: My spyglass! Not a scratch on it! Here, take this book. The spell inside is yours now. Learn it well!

after.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
after.text: You should go see Mayor Ostrin. He's been pacing up and down the big dock all morning.

journal.text: Recover Ambrus' spyglass from the Urchins of the east shore.

journal_done.text: Speak with Mayor Ostrin on the big dock.

rumour.specifics: Three villagers of Vesk: Mott mending nets, Brynna at the smokehouse, old Tib on the shore.

rumour1.speaker: Mott
rumour1.text: Sorry, I've got nets to mend. Try me later.

rumour2.speaker: Brynna
rumour2.text: That Master Odrel is a stingy old wizard! He ate up all our smoked eel last summer and never paid a copper!

rumour3.speaker: Tib
rumour3.text: Stay away from the water after dark. The dead come up out of it!

shop_greeting.specifics: Hulda of the Leaky Bucket inn, Bodkin Mudd the arms dealer who also sells bait, Dorgo of the potion shop.

inn.speaker: Hulda
inn.text: Welcome to the Leaky Bucket. Not many folk come out this way since the dead started walking. Take any room you like, they're all empty.

arms.speaker: Bodkin Mudd
arms.text: Welcome to Mudd's! Finest blades on the lake, and the fattest worms! Go on, smell one. Fresh dug this mornin'!

magic.speaker: Dorgo
magic.text: Ah, a customer! My potions cost a bit more than in the city. But then, the city is a long row away, isn't it?

two_givers.specifics: Pruitt the Lamplighter, driven from his lighthouse by the dead, wants the Beacon Lens brought back; Bodkin Mudd wants to sell his house on stilts for 40,000 gold.

offer_a.speaker: Pruitt the Lamplighter
offer_a.text: Gaaahhh! Stay back! Stay back! ... Oh. Oh, you're alive. Forgive me, I took you for one of the dead. Go to my lighthouse on the north point and bring me the Beacon Lens. They drove me out before I could take it. Without the light our boats can't find their way home at night. And mind you don't drop it! It's very old.

offer_b.speaker: Bodkin Mudd
offer_b.text: Say, stranger! You look like somebody who needs a house! I got just the one. Up on stilts, right out over the lake, and the fish jump right into yer kitchen! Yours for 40,000 gold. A steal!

outcome_a.speaker: Pruitt the Lamplighter
outcome_a.text: The Beacon Lens! Not even cracked! Here are 150 gold pieces for your trouble. Tonight the light burns again!

outcome_b.speaker: Bodkin Mudd
outcome_b.text: Back for the house, are ya? Ha, ha... Funny story. She sank last night, stilts and all! Still want her? I'll knock off a hundred gold.

journal_a.text: Bring the Beacon Lens back to Pruitt the Lamplighter.

journal_b.text: Buy Bodkin Mudd's house for 40,000 gold.

rescue.specifics: Hesk, a gruff net maker; Imps carried off his crow Inky, cage and all, and Inky holds the key to the Imps' next cage.

plea.speaker: Hesk
plea.text:
Greetings, stranger.

My crow's gone. Inky. Imps came in the night and took him, cage and all.

Tell you what. You bring him back alive and I'll give you something I pulled out of the lake. Worth your while. Deal?

reminder.speaker: Hesk
reminder.text: No crow? Imps like holes in the ground. Try the old well behind the smokehouse.

found.speaker: Inky
found.text: Rawk! Over here! Get me out! Take the key, take the key! It opens the other cage! Rawk!

following.speaker: Inky
following.text: Rawk! Home! Take me home to Hesk!

completion.speaker: Hesk
completion.text:
Inky! You old fool, look at you. Thanks, stranger.

Here's what I promised. A robe. Fished it out of the lake last spring, all wet and weedy. Nobody ever came asking for it.

journal.text: Find Hesk's crow and bring him home.

main_opening.specifics: Joss points the player to Mayor Ostrin, who sends him to the Weeping Isle after the Necromancer Vezzek.

herald.speaker: Joss
herald.text: You're the one Master Odrel sent? Mayor Ostrin is expecting you. Big house at the end of the main dock.

opening.speaker: Mayor Ostrin
opening.text:
Grim tidings, lad. Last night the dead walked up out of Lake Mirrow and dragged some of our fishermen right off the dock. We could hear the poor souls screaming all the way to the Weeping Isle.

It is the Necromancer Vezzek. He has made the Isle his home, and the drowned answer to him now!

By the authorization of this village, I command you to cross to the Weeping Isle and put an end to Vezzek. Ambrus the Ferryman can take you across. Go!

reminder.speaker: Mayor Ostrin
reminder.text: Go! Vezzek grows bolder with every night!

journal.text: Cross to the Weeping Isle and defeat the Necromancer Vezzek.
